name: Equal-budget nested tuning sensitivity for four classical title classifiers
target: prediction of supplied binary corpus labels from normalized title text

fold_design.construction: StratifiedGroupKFold on the combined-text C1 population with Jaccard >= 0.80 components; title rows inherit the resulting fold
fold_design.tfidf_fitting: inner or outer training partition only

tie_breaking: model parameter closest to the fixed comparator

interpretation_limits: Equal candidate counts do not guarantee equal effective search difficulty across algorithms.
PolitiFact and GossipCop had informed earlier analyses before this equalized experiment, so the external comparisons are post-selection robustness evidence rather than confirmatory tests.
The target is corpus-label predictability, not claim-level factual truth.
Small statistically detectable changes on the large GossipCop sample should be interpreted together with absolute balanced accuracy near 50%.
